positions.name: AsyncRememberContractSemantics
positions.frame: what does the ratified async job contract for remember guarantee about return timing, work-loss, and reaction delivery?
positions.why: All three expressions describe the same ratified mechanism from converging angles: src-1 announces the ratification and names the core artifact (receipt returned in seconds, cursor-polled extraction); src-2 asserts the properties that follow (no blocking, no lost work); src-3 restates the settled dispatch-and-poll/piggyback pattern as the 'key decision.' The directional passes back this reading — all three sit in the same technical register (pipeline-native vocabulary as default voice), the same decision-grade conviction, and calm-positive affect, with src-1 and src-3 both enacting authority-ranking via ratification/decision framing. No tension: each statement adds a facet of the same contract's specification rather than contesting it.
